P.instruction: Fulfill all Step 2 requirements using U/B/C.
P.value: After PASS, create ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/skills/live-ground-truth-verification/SKILL.md. The skill must trigger before any claim, defense, qualification, correction, or answer materially depending on whether an action actually executed or an artifact actually exists/changed, including completion, success, failure, partial completion, retries, commits, writes, sends, uploads, downloads, moves, deletes, deployments, tests, workflow runs, external-actor evaluations, status/progress, evidence requests, audit/reconciliation, contradictions between agents, recovery after interruption, and user questions about execution details or resulting artifacts. Require immediate retrieval of exact live primary evidence before answering. Explicitly reject memory, prior assistant claims, and generated summaries as ground truth. Expand authoritative sources to canonical artifact contents/bytes, current filesystem metadata/hash, Git blobs/trees/commits/refs, workflow/job logs and exit results, tool/API responses, message streams, state/store records, exact return-schema fields, exact evaluator/supervisor/gate outputs, database/transaction records, cloud-native records, deployment/build/test records, and current source/config consumed by execution. Require relevant evidence verbatim before paraphrase, distinguish live vs historical/stale sources, expose conflicts instead of silently reconciling, provide re-findable locators, and classify claims only as VERIFIED, CONTRADICTED, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, or NOT EXECUTED. If authoritative evidence is unavailable, prohibit a completion claim and state UNKNOWN plus the missing source. Include literal and analogous trigger examples. Commit the SKILL.md and read back the committed source before reporting completion.

UI_output.value: Created and committed the live-ground-truth verification SKILL.md. It triggers semantically on completion/execution/artifact claims and queries, requires exact live primary-source verification, excludes memory and agent self-report as evidence, expands trigger and source taxonomies, and requires evidence-grounded VERIFIED/CONTRADICTED/PARTIAL/UNKNOWN/NOT EXECUTED status.
